# Definition

This folder holds the precise operational definitions and calculation rules for the clinical quality indicators tracked by the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It specifies the exact time windows, clinical scoring thresholds (such as ASA and Charlson scores), and administrative SKS codes required to measure outcomes like 30-day mortality, timely antibiotic administration, CT scanning, preoperative optimization, and surgical intervention for conditions like perforation or ileus. By standardizing these metrics, the definitions ensure that hospital performance and patient care pathways are evaluated consistently across Denmark.

## Pages

- [[definition|Definition]] — Details the exact clinical criteria, timeframes, and coding requirements (e.g., SKS-code NAAZ42, Charlson thresholds) used to calculate AKDB's primary and supplementary quality indicators.
